About.Slogan: Plain text editor ++ Markdown ++ Diff ++ Git
About.Text:
Eel-ditor {0}

Plain text editor ++ Markdown ++ Diff ++ Git
Conflict.CountAt: Merge conflicts in this file: {0}. Caret in conflict {1}.
Conflict.NoneLeft: No conflict markers are left, but git still sees the file as unresolved.
Convert.DoneSkipped: Converted: {0}; left as they are: {1} (the change would alter what the text shows)
Convert.Tip: Changes only the markers (==, **, *) of the spans in the selection, or in the whole file without a selection. Ctrl+Z undoes.
Cyrillic.Tip: Changes the selection or the whole file. Ctrl+Z undoes.
Cyrillic.Tip.isv: The official Interslavic alphabets: ě = є, y = ы, j = ј, lj = љ, nj = њ, dž = дж; etymological letters (ę ų ȯ ć đ…) too. Changes the selection or the whole file; Ctrl+Z undoes.
Cyrillic.Tip.ru: Scientific transliteration: š č ž x šč ja ju ë è y, ʹ = ь, ʺ = ъ (typed h and ' work too). Changes the selection or the whole file; Ctrl+Z undoes.
Cyrillic.Tip.sr: Gaj's Latin ↔ Vuk's Cyrillic, letter for letter: lj = љ, nj = њ, dž = џ, đ = ђ, ć = ћ, j = ј. Changes the selection or the whole file; Ctrl+Z undoes.
Cyrillic.Tip.uk: Scientific transliteration: h = г, g = ґ, y = и, i = і, je = є, ji = ї, ja ju šč, ʹ = ь, ʼ = apostrophe. Changes the selection or the whole file; Ctrl+Z undoes.
Cyrillic.ViewOn: The text is shown in Cyrillic; the file is not changed. Editing is off until you switch back (Encoding menu).
Diff.LayoutOnly: No word changed — only the line breaks
Diff.LinePanelResizeTip: Drag to change the panel's height; double click for the automatic height.
Diff.RevertAllTip: Restores the whole file to the left version. The file is not saved; Ctrl+Z undoes it.
Diff.RevertChangeTip: Restores the left version of the current block. The file is not saved; Ctrl+Z undoes it.
Diff.Summary: Changes: {0} · lines on the right: {1} · on the left: {2}
Diff.SyncScrollTip: Scroll both sides together, keeping matching lines side by side
Diff.WordModeTip: One text instead of two columns: removed words struck through in red, added words in green. Read-only; click again to go back to two columns.
Encoding.ReopenDiscard: The file has unsaved changes that will be lost. Continue?
Export.NoBrowser: PDF files are printed by Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome or Chromium, and none of them was found. Install one, or export to HTML and print that.
Find.ConfirmReplaceInFiles: Replace {0} occurrences in {1} files? Files open in the editor are changed only in the buffer (you can undo); the others are saved to disk.
Find.InFilesDone: Found {0} occurrences in {1} files ({2} files searched, {3} s).
Find.Timeout: The regular expression took too long and was stopped.
Git.ConfirmDiscard:
Discard uncommitted changes? This cannot be undone.

{0}
Git.ConfirmUntrack: Stop tracking {0}? The file stays on disk and is removed from the repository in the next commit.
Git.NoRepository: The current file is not in a git repository
Git.NoRepositoryHint: Open a file from a git repository to see its changes.
Git.NotAvailable: git was not found in PATH.
Git.NotInHead: {0} is not in HEAD yet; comparing with an empty file.
Git.NotInRepo: {0} is not in a git repository.
Git.RevertDiscardsEditor: The file also has unsaved changes in the editor. They will be lost.
Git.UnsavedBeforeCommit: Some files of this repository have unsaved changes that will not be committed. Continue?
Help.ColumnSelection:
Column (rectangular) selection:

• Alt + drag with the mouse
• Alt+Shift + arrow keys

Typing, pasting and deleting then work on all selected lines.
History.Title: History: {0} ({1})
Info.Binary: The file looks binary. Editing and saving may damage it.
Info.ChangedOnDisk: The file was changed on disk by another program, and the editor has unsaved changes.
Info.Deleted: The file was deleted or moved. Saving will create it again.
Info.Joined: Joined {0} lines into {1} paragraphs. No word changed — the word diff shows it.
Info.Lossy: Not all bytes could be read as {0}. Saving will change the file. Choose another encoding.
Info.MixedEol: The file has mixed line endings. The editor keeps them as they are; new lines get {0}.
Info.NothingToConvert: Nothing to convert: the file already follows this convention.
Info.Reflowed: Split {0} long lines (the longest now has {1} characters). No word changed — the word diff shows it.
Link.NotFound: The linked file was not found: {0}
Md.ClearedSkipped: Formatting removed: {0}; left as they are: {1} (the change would alter what the text shows)
Md.StyleSkipped: Skipped parts that cannot be formatted this way without changing the text or the table: {0}.
Menu.Compare.CopyAllLeft: Copy all changes to the left
Menu.File.Console: Open console in the file's folder
Menu.Md.ClearFormatTip: Removes bold, italic, strikethrough, highlight, code, sub/superscript and links from the selection (without one: at the caret). Headings and lists stay.
Menu.Md.Heading: Heading
Menu.Md.ImageTip: Inserts ![name](path) with a path relative to the file. Images can also be dragged from Explorer into the text.
Menu.Md.List.Tip: A new item with the same marker; a numbered list is renumbered. Enter in an item starts the next one, Shift+Enter a new line inside the item, Enter on an empty item ends the list.
Menu.Md.List.RenumberTip: Numbers the items of this list 1, 2, 3… without gaps or repeats; only the numbers change.
Menu.Md.RawTip: Shows Markdown as plain text: all markup visible, no formatting.
Menu.Md.Table.SplitTip: Starts a new table at the current row (above it the first table ends); the new one gets a copy of the header.
Menu.Md.TaskTip: Checks or unchecks the task on the current line; turns another line into a task. The box can also be clicked.
Menu.Settings.AutoReload: Reload files changed on disk automatically
Results.Title: Search results
Save.Unencodable: Some characters cannot be saved in {0} (lines: {1}). Save as UTF-8?
Settings.LanguageRestart: The interface language will change after Eel-ditor is restarted.
Settings.LargeFileHelp: Files larger than this open without syntax highlighting, Markdown view and word wrap, so even huge logs open quickly and the editor stays responsive. You can turn these on for a particular file: “Display as” in the file's menu (or click the file type in the status bar) and View → Word wrap.
Settings.NoBoldHelp: This font has no separate bold face (common with variable fonts), so Markdown bold will not show.
Settings.NotMonospace: Proportional font: columns and Markdown tables will not line up.
Side.GitTip: Displays the repo of the current file
Status.Chord: {0} was pressed, waiting for the second key…
Status.Reloaded: {0} changed on disk and was reloaded.
Switcher.Filter: Type a name or part of a path…
Table.CellEditTip: Enter and Shift+Enter add a new line, Ctrl+Enter and Esc end the edit (the change stays; Ctrl+Z undoes it), Tab / Shift+Tab and the arrows at the edge of the text move to the neighbouring cell. Only this cell's text changes. With word wrap on, a double click opens a cell too.
Table.CellProblem.CellCount: this change would break the table row.
Table.CellProblem.OtherCells: this change would alter other cells.
Table.ColumnSelected: Column selected. Use Copy column (TSV) in Markdown → Table.
Table.Copied: Copied {0} rows (Markdown and a table for Word)
Table.Pasted: Pasted {0} rows above the current row
Wrap.ConventionDiffers: New text will be broken differently from the rest of this file. Click to use the file's convention, or to split its long lines.
Wrap.ConventionTip: How the paragraphs of this file are broken (most of them). Click to split its long lines.
Wrap.Join: Convert to one line per paragraph
Wrap.NoParagraph: The caret is not in a text paragraph.
Wrap.ReflowTip: Lays out the paragraph at the caret (or those in the selection) in the chosen style. Only the line breaks change, not the text.
Wrap.SentencesTip: Semantic line breaks: a new sentence starts on a new line (after . ! ?; not after abbreviations like “e.g.”). Changing one sentence changes one line in git.
Wrap.Tip: How new paragraphs are broken while typing. Existing paragraphs are left as they are (clean git history); Alt+Q reflows a paragraph on request.
Menu.View.PreviewTip: A preview of an HTML or Markdown file next to the text, drawn by Eel-ditor itself (no browser: no scripts, CSS or content from the internet). It follows your typing.
Preview.NotAvailable: The preview is available for HTML and Markdown files.
Preview.TooLarge: The file is too large to preview.
Menu.File.PrintTip: Opens the document in the default browser with its print dialog (print preview, printer, save as PDF).
Print.Opened: The document is open in the browser for printing.
Panel.ByNameTip: One list, alphabetically by file name
Panel.ByDateTip: One list, the most recently modified files first (saved on disk)
Menu.Edit.PastePlainTip: Pastes the text only, without the formatting, lists and tables from Word
Menu.Edit.SpecialCharTip: Any Unicode character, chosen by category (arrows, mathematical symbols, Cyrillic…)
CharMap.Title: Special characters
CharMap.Search: Search: a character or a code (U+2713)
CharMap.Hint: Click a character to insert it
